entities.name: Towazu
entities.description: Great kami of the Forbidden and things unspeakable on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Lady Azami Ozu
entities.description: Warned that learning Towazu's name brings obsession and madness.

events.summary: Students at the Minamo school summon Towazu.
events.quote: It was summoned by students at the Minamo school

events.summary: Towazu appears before seekers of knowledge, leaving them comatose or insane.
events.quote: leaving their owners comatose or insane with the arcane knowledge it imparted

events.summary: Lady Azami Ozu warns about learning Towazu's name.
events.quote: will invite obsession, followed by paranoia and madness as more is learned
